title: Places in Town

expressions.example: The bank is right around the corner.
The hotel is in the middle of nowhere.
This restaurant is off the beaten path.
I always get lost near the station.

sentences: The bank is next to the supermarket.
The park is behind the school.
The museum is between the library and the church.
The pharmacy is across from the hospital.
The bus stop is in front of the mall.
The hotel is near the station.
The bakery is on the corner.
The bridge is over the river.

grammar.title: Preposições de Lugar — Next to, Behind, Between
rules: "Next to" = ao lado de: The bank is next to the park.
"Behind" = atrás de, "In front of" = na frente de.
"Between" = entre (dois lugares): The museum is between the bank and the church.

rows: The pharmacy is next to the bank.
The park is behind the school.
The bus stop is in front of the mall.
The library is between the bank and the church.
The hotel is across from the station.

quiz.q: The bank is ___ the supermarket. (ao lado de)
The museum is ___ the library and the church.
The park is ___ the school. (atrás de)
The hotel is ___ the station. (em frente a)
The bus stop is ___ the mall. (na frente de)

speak: The bank is next to the park.
The museum is between two buildings.
The park is behind the school.
The hotel is across from the station.
